# Cueto Law Group

> > Miami-based business and corporate law firm led by Santiago Cueto, specializing in commercial contracts, defamation litigation, and business dispute resolution across Florida.

Cueto Law Group serves clients throughout Miami-Dade and Broward counties with comprehensive business legal services. The firm has secured over $500 million in client victories and provides expertise in contract law, commercial litigation, and corporate legal matters under Florida law.
